visual_prompt: An interactive pricing gauge. As simulated 'competitor stock' drops to zero, the agent's algorithmic needle visually pushes the product price up, flashing green as the projected revenue margin expands.
A heatmap showing real-time demand spikes across different regions, which the agent uses to localized pricing.
An interactive graph showing how the agent models price elasticity to find the optimal profit-maximizing point.
An animated revenue surge dashboard with stockout alert badges (📈 Surge Graph, 🛍️ Product SKU, ⚡ Competitor Stock zero 🛑, 🚀 +15% Price Adjust, 💵 Profit Maximizer), with interactive stock triggers.
